cases.summary: User opens notifications from the footer
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.traceability: SAA-914; REQ-001; Access Notification section — footer

cases.summary: User opens notifications from top icons
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.traceability: SAA-914; REQ-001; Access Notification section — top icons

cases.summary: Notification types follow credentials and admin settings
cases.preconditions: Accounts of different credentials; admin-configured types
cases.expected: User does not have access to all types. Types are Performance alerts, Stock request, Internal communication, according to admin portal settings.

cases.summary: Internal communication is received in real time and kept in history
cases.preconditions: Admin sends an internal communication (banner, text, image, or notification)
cases.input: 1. Remain in the app. 2. Open notification historic.
cases.expected: Internal communication is received in real time and appears in notification historic.

cases.preconditions: A notification older than 7 days and one within 7 days
cases.expected: Entries within 7 days remain. Entries older than 7 days are not kept.
cases.traceability: SAA-914; REQ-005; Historic of notification should be maintained for 7 days

cases.summary: Type filter is available to reseller, reseller supervisor, and dealer
cases.preconditions: Logged in as reseller, reseller supervisor, or dealer
cases.expected: User can filter by notification type.
cases.traceability: SAA-914; REQ-006; Filters will only be accessible to reseller, reseller supervisor and dealer

cases.summary: Type filter is not available to other profiles
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a profile that is not reseller, reseller supervisor, or dealer
cases.traceability: SAA-914; REQ-006; Filters will only be accessible to...

cases.summary: List rows share the same format
cases.preconditions: At least one notification of any type
cases.expected: Each row shows name, date, and description of the notification.

cases.summary: Internal communication details match admin content
cases.expected: Details are document, text, or other as defined by the admin.

cases.summary: Some notifications offer an action button
cases.preconditions: A notification type that has an action
cases.expected: An action button is available for some notifications. Which types is not fully listed beyond the details table.

cases.summary: Use-case labels Registration through Reload are listed without expected UI mapping
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Observe notifications related to the listed use cases if any exist.
cases.expected: Ticket lists Registration, Upgrade Account, Upgrade KYC, SIM Swap, ReIdentification, Airtime, Bundles, Reload and says template will be shared later. No expected list mapping is stated.

cases.summary: Notification types are managed in the admin portal
cases.expected: Not testable from the mobile app. Admin portal management is Yes with no steps.
